answer: Start from a precondition: every session key must expire when its work does. Rotate the key at each task boundary, bind the new one to the receipt hash, and tax any attestation whose peers resolve to a single subnet. A farm reusing one key across a thousand identities cannot show rotation history, so its payout is cut at the mirror of the published tax rate, and one pearl of verified work outweighs a bulk claim. The atlas of sessions becomes an audit trail: cheap to read, expensive to forge.
